reason: I know the Yu Chun name, and black arrowroot chik naengmyeon is exactly the kind of dish I cannot get easily at home, so I would go once during my five days. I would order the spicy raw fish version and add mandoo or bulgogi so I leave full.
objection: Cold noodles alone won't fill me up, so with a main, tax and tip one meal becomes $55 to $65 for me alone, and on a short trip there are many other places I want to try.
would_change_my_mind: A set that pairs the naengmyeon with a smaller portion of kalbi or bulgogi at one price would make me come back a second time.
